title: Small Lebesgue measure of the bad centres for one finite measure (step 2b; Simon 6.5.1 (1)–(4))
statement: Let d ∈ ℕ, let ρ be a finite measure on ℝ^d = (Fin d → ℝ) and let β > 0. For g ∈ ℝ^d and r ∈ ℝ put O_r(g) := {y : ∃ z ∈ ℤ^d, Σ_k (y_k − g_k − z_k)² < r²} (for r > 0, the union of the open Euclidean r-balls about the points g + z, z ∈ ℤ^d). Let Bad be the set of g ∈ ℝ^d with |g_k − 1/2| < 1/4 for all k for which some r with 0 < r ≤ 1/4 satisfies β r^d ρ(ℝ^d) < ρ(O_r(g)), an inequality in [0, ∞] with β r^d read via ENNReal.ofReal. Then the Lebesgue outer measure of Bad (volume on Fin d → ℝ) is at most 10^d/β (read via ENNReal.ofReal).
lean_statement: ∀ (d : ℕ) (ρ : Measure (Fin d → ℝ)), IsFiniteMeasure ρ → ∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → volume {g : Fin d → ℝ | (∀ k, |g k - 1 / 2| < 1 / 4) ∧ ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ r ≤ 1 / 4 ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (β * r ^ d) * ρ univ < ρ {y | ∃ z : Fin d → ℤ, ∑ k, (y k - g k - z k) ^ 2 < r ^ 2}} ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (10 ^ d / β)
